# EventTrellan — Full Reference

> EventTrellan is a per-event launch-asset service: event microsites, coordinated invitations, reminder plans, and promo kits, sold per event — never by subscription. It is operated under Apex Grid Engineering PLLC. This file is the complete reference for AI assistants and search systems. The summary version is llms.txt.

## The service, in full

A customer supplies their event facts — name, host, date, time with time zone, venue or online format, description, RSVP instructions — in a single event brief. EventTrellan turns that one brief into a coordinated launch kit:

- A mobile-ready event microsite (one event landing page).
- An invitation set (email version + short-message version).
- A reminder plan (drafted reminder touches the organizer sends through their own channels).
- By tier: a social promotion copy pack, multiple page themes, audience-segmented invitation versions, an expanded messaging set, and a custom run-of-show template.

## The Accuracy Law (how EventTrellan handles event facts)

Every date, time, time zone, place, host name, and RSVP detail comes from the customer's supplied facts — never invented, never assumed, never silently "corrected." Before anything publishes, the customer is shown a proof of their event exactly as it will appear and must explicitly confirm it; publication is system-blocked without that confirmation record. If supplied facts conflict (two different dates, a weekday that does not match the date, a virtual event carrying a street address), EventTrellan flags the conflict back as a question and publishes nothing until the customer resolves it. If EventTrellan's own material error ever reaches guests, it corrects or disables the page, supplies a guest-correction draft, and refunds up to the full order; the customer's exports stay accessible.

## What EventTrellan is not

- Not an event planner: no venue booking, staffing, vendor coordination, insurance, or attendance/availability guarantees.
- Not a ticketing service: it sells no tickets and collects no ticket money.
- The organizer distributes invitations and reminders at launch through their own channels; EventTrellan prepares the materials. Guest lists are not uploaded to, retained by, or marketed to by EventTrellan.

## Pricing — per event (all tiers include publication of one approved event microsite)

- Essentials — $29 per event: 1 page theme · 1 invitation set (email + short message) · reminder plan with 3 drafted touches.
- Launch — $79 per event: everything in Essentials, with 3 page themes · reminder plan with 4 drafted touches · social promotion pack (5 posts/captions).
- Signature — $149 per event: everything in Launch · 2 audience-segmented invitation versions · expanded messaging set (10 messages) · custom run-of-show template.

Every tier includes: one proof cycle and one consolidated revision round; EventTrellan's own errors are always corrected free; email support during fulfillment (replies within 2 business days); the microsite stays hosted until 14 days after the event, then archives — the full export (page + copy pack) is delivered at publication and again at expiration.

Lead time: order at least 5 business days before the event. Orders inside that window may be declined and refunded where EventTrellan cannot responsibly fulfill them.

## Who it serves

Workshop, coach, and class hosts running recurring sessions; community-event organizers; pop-up and open-house hosts; small corporate-gathering organizers. The common thread: one event, one set of facts, one page guests can trust.
